description: This file defines a Java interface 'PersistenceIdsConfig' that provides configuration settings for persistence ID streaming, including various timeout and backoff parameters and an enumeration of default values.

classes.name: PersistenceIdsConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying configuration methods for persistence ID streaming, including batch size, timeouts, backoff durations, restart limits, and recovery period.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the amount of persistence IDs to request from a remote service per message.

methods.name: getStreamRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum time to wait for a SourceRef reply when requesting a stream.

methods.name: getStreamIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum time to keep the persistence ID stream open in the absence of downstream consumption.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration in case of stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration in case of stream failure.

methods.name: getMaxRestarts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of stream resumptions before giving up.

methods.name: getRecovery
methods.description: Returns the period after which upstream is considered healthy if no error occurred.
